title: Red Hat Security Advisory: gstreamer1-plugins-good security update
description: A security vulnerability in the gstreamer1-plugins-good package for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 10 allows local file disclosure via unvalidated file:// URIs in the adaptivedemux2 manifest handling component. This issue is tracked as CVE-2026-121629 and has been rated with an Important security impact by Red Hat. An update addressing this vulnerability is available in version 1.26.7-10.el10_3.1 of the package.
